author: Nate Miller
title: Cameron Cauley called up from minors
desc: Cameron Cauley was called up from Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
impact: Cauley will join the Rangers ahead of Monday's game in Cleveland. It will be the versatile 23-year-old's first trip up to the bigs. Cauley has hit .262 with eight homers and stolen 29 bases without being caught over 74 games in the minors this year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) expected to be activated this week
desc: Emilio Pagan is expected to return from the 15-day injured list this week.
impact: Pagan tossed scoreless innings in rehab appearances on Friday and Sunday. He should step back into his closer role when he is activated.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Cole Sands (forearm) throws bullpen Saturday
desc: Twins right-hander Cole Sands (forearm) threw a bullpen session on Saturday and was reportedly encouraged by the results.
impact: Sands has been on the 15-day injured list since May 2 with a mild right forearm strain, and Saturday marked his first bullpen session since hitting the shelf. Sands posted a 4.63 ERA in 12 appearances before hitting the IL.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Anthony Banda (side) leaves early Sunday
desc: Twins left-hander Anthony Banda (side) left Sunday's game against the Rockies after just one pitch in the ninth inning.
impact: Banda recorded the final two outs of the eighth inning before hitting the leadoff man in the ninth and exiting the game. There is no update on Banda's side injury as he will be evaluated in the coming days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Paddack close to deal with Rangers
desc: The Rangers are reportedly close to a deal with Chris Paddack.
impact: Paddack was designated for assignment by the Reds last week. He would add pitching depth for Texas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Semien diagnosed with Grade 3 left hip flexor strain
desc: Marcus Semien was diagnosed with a Grade 3 left hip flexor strain.
impact: Semien is expected to be sidelined at least 4-to-6 weeks after being placed on the injured list last Thursday.

author: Nate Miller
title: Drew Pomeranz inks deal with Cubs
desc: Drew Pomeranz joined the Cubs on a minor-league contract.
impact: Pomeranz actually signed his minor-league contract with the Cubs last week and pitched for Triple-A Iowa over the weekend. Pomeranz was released by the Angels earlier this month after posting a 5.01 ERA over 25 relief appearances. Pomeranz was excellent for the Cubs last year, putting up a 2.17 ERA across 57 appearances. The Cubs are hoping he can regain that form.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Brady Singer knocked around in loss to Pirates Sunday
desc: Reds right-hander Brady Singer allowed five earned runs on nine hits in 4 1/3 innings while taking the loss on Sunday against the Pirates.
impact: After tossing seven scoreless innings against the Brewers his last time out, Sunday marked a notable step back for Singer. He was knocked around for nine hits, including a pair of home runs, although he didn't walk a batter while striking out six. Singer's 4.47 xFIP and 4.40 SIERA both sit well below his 5.12 ERA on the season, so perhaps some regression is still headed his way moving forward. He lines up to take on the Orioles at home next weekend.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jhoan Duran closes the door on Mets in Sunday's win
desc: Jhoan Duran allowed no hits and one walk during a scoreless ninth inning to earn the save in Sunday's 5-4 win over the Mets.
impact: Duran just continues to get it done at the back of the Philadelphia bullpen. The hard-throwing righty converted his 21st save of the season Sunday, as he's blown just one opportunity while posting an elite 1.57 ERA over 30 appearances.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jesus Luzardo solid over five frames in Sunday's win
desc: Jesus Luzardo allowed one run on four hits and three walks while striking out six over five innings in Sunday's 5-4 win against the Mets.
impact: With three free passes issued between the fourth and fifth innings, Luzardo's pitch count got up a bit, leading to his exit after five frames. Still, the lefty turned in a solid outing, and he continues to rack up the strikeouts at a rapid pace. Over his last four starts, Luzardo has put up an impressive 1.85 ERA with 36 punch outs across 24 1/3 innings. He'll look to keep rolling Saturday in Kansas City.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Shane Bieber takes no-decision Sunday versus Rangers
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Shane Bieber allowed two earned runs across 5 1/3 innings in a no-decision on Sunday against the Rangers.
impact: Bieber improved after getting shelled in his season debut his last time out, allowing just a pair of earned runs while pitching into the sixth inning. At the same time, he also allowed five hits, including a homer, while walking another four against four strikeouts on the afternoon. Nonetheless, some rust was likely expected given his lengthy absence from a big-league mound. He lines up to take the ball on Saturday afternoon in Seattle.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Nathan Lukes slugs homer in loss to Rangers Sunday
desc: Blue Jays outfielder Nathan Lukes went 2-for-4 with a two-run homer in a 3-2 loss to the Rangers on Sunday.
impact: Lukes tied the game at two with a clutch two-run homer in the bottom of the eighth inning on Sunday. Unfortunately, the Rangers scored a go-ahead run on a two-base wild pitch in the ninth to escape with a 3-2 win. The long ball was Lukes' fourth of the season and his second over his last five games. He has also logged back-to-back two-hit efforts and is up to a .310/.357/.439 slash line with four homers, 18 runs, and 17 RBI through 170 plate appearances on the season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kyle Schwarber reaches 30 homers in just 80 games
desc: Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-5 with a two-run homer, a stolen base, and two runs scored in Sunday's 5-4 win over the Mets.
impact: Immediately after the Mets rallied from three runs down to take a 4-3 lead, Schwarber stepped to the plate with one on in the top of the seventh inning to deliver what would turn out to be the game-winning shot. It was Schwarber's 30th homer of the season, as the veteran slugger is now five ahead of the pack in that column. He also added his second steal of the season to go with 54 RBI and 54 runs.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jack Flaherty impresses in return from IL Sunday
desc: Tigers right-hander Jack Flaherty pitched five scoreless innings with nine strikeouts in a no-decision on Sunday against the Astros.
impact: After a short stint on the injured list, Flaherty was rather dominant against the Astros in his return from a leg injury. The veteran allowed just two hits and three walks while striking out nine across his five innings of work. He was in line for the win before the Astros rallied off of the Tigers bullpen in an eventual 7-5 Astros win in 10 innings. Flaherty now sports a 4.97 ERA through 16 starts, and with the Tigers potentially moving to a six-man rotation upon his return, he lines up to take on the Rangers on the road next Sunday.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Matt Vierling swipes a bag in loss to Astros Sunday
desc: Tigers outfielder Matt Vierling went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in a 7-5 loss to the Astros on Sunday.
impact: Vierling singled and stole second base with two out in the second inning but was stranded at second base. The swipe was the veteran's third of the season, although he is slumping through a dismal campaign at the plate. While battling a couple IL stints, Vierling has slashed .203/.259/.338 with five gome3rs, 18 runs, and 27 RBI to go with his three stolen bases on the campaign.
